title: The Double-Edged Nature of the Rashomon Set for Trustworthy Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2511.21799v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Real-world machine learning (ML) pipelines rarely produce a single model; instead, they produce a Rashomon set of many near-optimal ones. We show that this multiplicity reshapes key aspects of trustworthiness. At the individual-model level, sparse interpretable models tend to preserve privacy but are fragile to adversarial attacks. In contrast, the diversity within a large Rashomon set enables reactive robustness: even when an attack compromises one model, a practitioner can switch to a different near-optimal model that remains accurate, without retraining. However, the same diversity increases information leakage, as disclosing more near-optimal models provides an attacker with progressively richer views of the training data. This produces a robustness-privacy trade-off governed by diversity, which we analyze theoretically and empirically. translated_title: 罗生门集在可信机器学习中的双刃剑本质
translated_abstract: 现实世界的机器学习（ML）流程很少产生单一模型；相反，它们会产生一个由许多近似最优模型组成的“罗生门集”（Rashomon set）。我们证明这种多重性重塑了可信性的关键方面。在单个模型层面，稀疏的可解释模型往往能保护隐私，但对对抗攻击较为脆弱。相比之下，大型罗生门集内部的多样性能够实现反应式鲁棒性：即使攻击危及某一个模型，从业者也可以切换到另一个仍然保持准确性的近似最优模型，而无需重新训练。然而，同样的多样性会增加信息泄露，因为披露越多的近似最优模型，攻击者就能获得对训练数据越丰富的视角。由此产生了一个由多样性主导的鲁棒性-隐私权衡，我们从理论和实证两方面对其进行了分析。除这一权衡之外，罗生门集在小的分布偏移下是稳定的，因此一个集合……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了由多个近似最优模型构成的罗生门集对可信机器学习的双刃剑作用：集合多样性既能通过切换到其他近似最优模型实现无需重训的反应式鲁棒性，又会因披露更多模型而加剧对训练数据的信息泄露，从而形成由多样性主导的鲁棒性-隐私权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the double-edged nature of the Rashomon set for trustworthy ML: the diversity of near-optimal models enables reactive robustness—switching to another accurate model without retraining after an attack—yet simultaneously increases information leakage about the training data, creating a diversity-governed robustness-privacy trade-off.
